summary: fractal-web binds the conversation pane to the composition Transcript, keeps the last verified transcript visible while refreshing, and re-opens an ended follow when its interest is re-acquired.

compatibility.detail: UI composition and client follow-lifecycle changes only; no server protocol change. Availability, history, send state, and empty state pass to the composition Transcript.

manual.detail: No installation action required. Refreshing does not replace the last verified transcript with an empty view. Returning to a conversation retries an ended follow while retained content stays honestly stale; a refused read reports its own failure without looping.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
